result.brief: 提出 Trace-WAM，在视频-动作联合学习中引入未来 3D 运动预测作为辅助目标，用三支 MoT 架构联合学习视频预测、运动预测与动作生成，提升分布外泛化。
result.reason: World action model coupling video prediction with action generation, adding 3D motion prediction as auxiliary representation objective; robot policy is main contribution so secondary direction.
